description: T3.2: runtime mesh trees. On the cabinet row (and the furnished room when downloaded), with GPU trees (what hosts get) and tinybvh only (the fallback): a new cabinet (a new mesh and instance) and then that cabinet replaced (updateMesh) must pass the oracle within 4 frames at a 60 Hz pace, on GPU trees; within 2 frames of that, the old tree and the GPU build's buffers must be freed (triangles in use equal to tinybvh only's); recompiles stay 0. Also recorded, not judged: a 100k-triangle mesh added at runtime (frames until seen) and its trace speed on the GPU tree against tinybvh only.
